blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and all six current pose renders confirms the sharply faceted bell silhouette, irregular pleats and jagged underside; crouch lifts front and side panels from the bent thighs, while the sit view leaves most upper thigh exposed and flares side/rear panels. V177 now isolates 266 rest-bound anterior thigh triangle samples per side: in sit only 5/266 left and 5/266 right same-side samples hit their corresponding front lap within the 250 mm diagnostic ray; each has only 1 sample within the diagnostic-only 30 mm distance. The deduplicated two-side lap union hits 21/532 samples. This measured response confirms the visible coverage defect; it does not establish a fit tolerance.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in front and posed views. Their cause is not established by the renders; visible surface quality is unacceptable and needs a separately measured diagnosis after the skirt response is isolated.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
